title: Sebastian and the Ghost
author: Bram Ashgrove
blurb: Silas Nakamura, an interpreter attached to a peace delegation destined to fail, has spent ten years following rules that keep getting rewritten. But when every record of a flight vanishes while it's still in the air, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, she must trade the one secret worth killing for before the border checkpoint shifts change.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
